name: sleep-forms-library
version: v1 (2026-09-22) - promoted from the fan-task scratch tool to tools/ymcc_sim/domains/sleep
generatedBy: ymcc_sim sleep domain (masked-testing line); analytical extraction only, no product data was modified
purpose: The REAL sleep/wake forms + densities observed on this machine, used as the evidence base for the sleep domain of the global simulator.

dataSources.role: operator-supplied historical log archive: one complete real sleep/wake cycle with the app running

sleepSide: suspend-keep-writer generation=2 (the writer is KEPT across this sleep)
s0-intent-joined-existing-suspend generation=2 -> the SAME physical sleep arriving twice is JOINED, never duplicated
wakeSide: s0-wake-message acceptedUserWake=true 23:32:06.856 -> three joined notifications reach the host as ONE resume edge
realCycleMeasured.afterWakeBursts: 4-5 device-change rows inside 60-70 ms were evaluated as 意外唤醒 but NOT re-slept (intentAgeEligible=false)

density.reading: 88.4% of consecutive device-change rows arrive within 200 ms = the burst shape the C4 form replays (upper bound)

sleepDurationsAsRestartGaps.reading: 18% flash cycles, 56% short (1-5 min), 17% medium, 8% long (>=30 min) => the long-sleep form must exist

codeConstants.name: SG_ENTRY_RETRY_DELAYS_MS
codeConstants.meaning: re-sleep ladder after entry failure and after a confirmed 意外唤醒

hostProtocol.staleShape: 409 POWER_EVENT_STALE (same-gen suspend after a Ready edge, or any lower generation)

forms.name: 无令牌请求（fail-closed 门）
forms.expect: 401 API_SESSION_REQUIRED

forms.name: 缺 generation（fail-closed 门）
forms.expect: 400 POWER_GENERATION_REQUIRED

forms.name: 非 native authority 入睡（fail-closed 门）
forms.expect: 403 F4_NATIVE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED

forms.name: 缺 source（fail-closed 门）
forms.expect: 400 POWER_GENERATION_REQUIRED

forms.name: 同代次过时入睡（跨代拒绝）
forms.expect: 409 POWER_EVENT_STALE + 状态不变

forms.name: 更低代次入睡（跨代拒绝）
forms.expect: 409 POWER_EVENT_STALE

forms.name: 更低代次唤醒（跨代拒绝）
forms.expect: 409 POWER_EVENT_STALE

forms.name: 正常短睡（1.5 s 压缩自真实 1–5 min）
forms.expect: 入睡 Suspended → 唤醒 AwaitingControl/On（真实边界）

forms.name: 长睡（>=30 min 门槛）
forms.expect: 压缩模式不触发 Host 内部门槛（SKIP）；真实等待需 -LongSleepReal

forms.name: 重复边沿幂等（双次投递）
forms.expect: 同代次第二次入睡 200+deduplicated；第二次唤醒绑定收据不二次重建

forms.name: 空转唤醒（无匹配入睡，fail-closed）
forms.expect: 409 HC_RESUME_RESULT_EXPIRED，状态不动

forms.name: 重复唤醒收据绑定（同代次）
forms.expect: 200 + 既有终态；不第二次 open/open-events

forms.name: 幻影唤醒（更高代次、无入睡）
forms.expect: 409 HC_RESUME_RESULT_EXPIRED
forms.source: Phantom wake after a host restart during sleep

forms.name: 误唤醒→瞬间重睡阶梯（500/1000/2000 ms）
forms.expect: 入睡→误唤醒→按阶梯重睡，全部 200

forms.name: 瞬间双次睡眠（闪醒后立刻第二次入睡）
forms.expect: 两次入睡在用户可感知的一次闪动内完成（<=3 s）

forms.name: 双观察者双次入睡投递
forms.expect: 第二次（新代次）被吸收为 deduplicated，不第二次 Close

forms.name: 密集风暴（10 循环 @150 ms，真实峰值 19/s）
forms.expect: 全部接受、无 503；风暴后状态一致

forms.name: 带会话睡眠（无曲线，干净入睡/唤醒）
forms.expect: 入睡边界释放租约；唤醒回到 AwaitingControl 且不伪造重开会话

forms.name: 曲线会话睡眠（safe/mock 无法证明 OEM 恢复 ⇒ fail-closed）
forms.expect: 入睡成 FaultLocked（powerState=Unknown）；唤醒 409 HC_RESUME_REBUILD_FAILED；mock 恢复不得伪装成物理读回

forms.name: 入睡中关闭竞争（晚到唤醒被 fail-closed）
forms.expect: close 后晚到唤醒 409 POWER_CLOSE_PENDING；终态 Stopped

unverifiedAssumption: The restart-gap proxy for sleep duration assumes the app auto-starts at logon after every wake; a manual app restart inside an awake session also produces a user-standby-cleared(process-start) row. The bins are therefore an upper bound on short cycles.
